author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect).** polaris-frontend/src/pages/setup.rs with 3 step components: 1) generate-key (button → POST /api/setup/generate-key, displays did:key on success), 2) publish-labeler-record (form: service-url + label-values input → POST /api/setup/publish-labeler-record), 3) publish-did-service (button → POST /api/setup/request-plc-signature, displays 'check email', text input for token, button → POST /api/setup/submit-plc-operation). Step transitions in Leptos signal. /api/setup/* endpoints land in #85 — frontend defines DTO shapes in api_client/dto.rs to align. Route added to app.rs. /  redirects to /setup when whoami.first_run.
